title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: NextStage Performance Theater, Grand Prairie | 2003
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the NextStage Performance Theater in Grand Prairie, Texas, USA, on 23 August 2003.

It was the 24th show by the eighth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 35 dates between July and September 2003.

Starr returned to the venue on 3 July 2006 and 11 October 2014.

The eighth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Paul Carrack: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • John Waite: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, guitar, bass, harmonica, flute
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
